policy.purpose: Valqeron uses AI to provide a governed AI control layer and ready-made workflows to business customers, and to support its own software development. It uses AI only for purposes defined and documented in this register.
policy.principles: Output of AI is decision support and is reviewed by a person before it is used; customers are told where AI is used; personal data is minimised and anonymised before it is sent to a language model; tenants are isolated; actions are recorded in an auditable log.
policy.risk_commitment: Every AI system and workflow is recorded in this register with at least one documented risk and mitigation. Risks are reviewed at least once a year and whenever a workflow changes materially.
policy.monitoring_commitment: Application errors are reported to an error-monitoring service without personal data. Incidents are recorded and followed up by the founder. Output quality is reviewed on a regular basis by a person; there is no automated continuous monitoring of model output.

ai_systems.name: Sales Lead Qualification
ai_systems.description: Lead intake, scoring 0-100 and ICP matching.
ai_systems.purpose: Support Valqeron's own sales intake and qualification.

risks.title: Lead score or ICP match may be wrong
risks.description: A score may over- or under-rate a lead and may reflect the configured ICP text rather than the real prospect.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: A salesperson reviews the score before contacting a lead; scores are not used for automated decisions.

ai_systems.name: Document Knowledge
ai_systems.purpose: Let staff query Valqeron's own documents.

risks.title: Answers may be inaccurate or point to the wrong document
risks.description: The model may misread a document or combine content from different documents.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: Answers are checked against the document snippets shown with the answer.

ai_systems.name: Invoice Processing
ai_systems.purpose: Extract fields from invoices Valqeron receives.

risks.title: Extracted invoice fields may be wrong
risks.description: Amounts, dates or counterparties may be misread.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: A person checks extracted amounts and counterparties before booking or payment.

ai_systems.name: Compliance Monitoring
ai_systems.purpose: Review Valqeron's own policies against the register.

risks.title: Compliance findings may be incomplete
risks.description: The output may miss a requirement or misjudge a policy.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: Treat the output as decision support; a responsible person confirms every finding.

ai_systems.name: Customer Support
ai_systems.purpose: Triage and draft replies for Valqeron's own support requests.

risks.title: Triage or suggested replies may be wrong
risks.description: A reply may be inaccurate or tone-deaf, or a request may be mis-prioritised.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: A person reviews suggested replies before they reach a customer.

ai_systems.name: HR Recruitment
ai_systems.description: Candidate screening and summaries. ON HOLD: this workflow is not used by Valqeron until a legal review has been completed.
ai_systems.purpose: On hold: not in use until a legal review (GDPR and EU AI Act) has been completed.

risks.title: Candidate screening may be inaccurate or discriminatory
risks.description: Recruitment and candidate assessment is a high-risk area under the EU AI Act (employment). A summary or score can be wrong or reflect bias. Legal classification to be confirmed.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: No automated rejection; a person makes every decision and checks the summary against the source; candidate data is anonymised before model use. Classification under the EU AI Act to be confirmed with legal advice.

ai_systems.name: Marketing Automation
ai_systems.purpose: Draft campaign ideas for Valqeron's own marketing.

risks.title: Campaign content may be inaccurate or off-brand
risks.description: The model may state unverified claims about products or compliance.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: A person reviews all content before publication, in particular any claim about the product or about compliance.

ai_systems.name: Meeting Agenda Assistant
ai_systems.purpose: Prepare agendas for Valqeron's own meetings.

risks.title: Agenda items may misstate context
risks.description: The agenda may misrepresent a topic or a participant's position.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: The organiser reviews the agenda before it is sent.

ai_systems.name: Quote & Contract Generator
ai_systems.description: Quote and contract drafts in Dutch or English.
ai_systems.purpose: Draft quotes and contract terms for Valqeron's own sales.

risks.title: Quote or contract text may contain wrong terms or unintended commitments
risks.description: The draft may state prices, terms or obligations that are not intended.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: Drafts are for review only; a person, and legal counsel where needed, approves before anything is sent. Anonymisation placeholders are restored only within the same request.

ai_systems.name: Business Intelligence
ai_systems.purpose: Summarise Valqeron's own business data for the founder.

risks.title: Insights may be wrong or overstated
risks.description: The model may infer trends from thin data or misstate numbers.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the model call (fail-closed: no call if the anonymisation layer is unavailable) and every run is recorded in a per-tenant, tamper-evident audit log. Process: Insights are decision support; the underlying data is checked by a person before decisions are taken.

ai_systems.name: Language model provider (OpenAI, gpt-4o-mini)
ai_systems.description: Third-party language model used by all workflows.
ai_systems.purpose: Generate the text of every workflow.

risks.title: Data goes to a third-party model provider
risks.description: Text sent to the provider leaves Valqeron's infrastructure; provider terms, retention and location are outside Valqeron's control.
risks.mitigation: Product: personal data is anonymised before the call. Open action: review the provider's data processing terms, retention and no-training settings and record the outcome (to be confirmed by the founder).

ai_systems.name: Anonymisation layer (Presidio and spaCy)
ai_systems.description: Detects and replaces personal data before the model call; restores placeholders in the output of the same request.
ai_systems.purpose: Keep personal data out of model calls.

risks.title: Anonymisation may miss personal data
risks.description: Detection is not perfect; names or identifiers may pass through unreplaced.
risks.mitigation: Product: fail-closed (no model call when the layer is unavailable); restoration uses only the mapping of the same request; unresolved placeholders are shown as [omitted]; restored text and mapping are not logged. Open action: build a test set to measure detection quality.

ai_systems.name: AI development assistants (Claude, Claude Code)
ai_systems.description: AI used to design, write and review Valqeron's own software.
ai_systems.purpose: Speed up development of the platform.

risks.title: Secrets or customer data exposed to AI tooling; AI-written code may contain defects
risks.description: Credentials or customer data could be pasted into a chat; generated code may contain bugs or security flaws.
risks.mitigation: Process: secrets are never put in chats (keys are placed on the server by the founder); AI sessions work from written hand-offs with stop conditions; changes go through CI tests and an automatic rollback on a failed deploy; production checks are read-only unless agreed.

ai_systems.name: Outbound reply classification (planned)
ai_systems.description: Planned AI classification of replies to outbound campaigns. Only the data model exists; not in production use.

risks.title: Replies may be misclassified and people who opted out may be contacted
risks.description: A wrong classification could lead to contact with someone who declined.
risks.mitigation: Not in use. Before use: a suppression-list check is required before any sending, and the system is reviewed and recorded here.
